title: Photographs of underground treasure cavern

tellings.quote: I've seen photographs of of the I mean it looks it's like a football stadium down underneath the ground, you know,

plain: A vast treasure trove is said to have been hidden in an underground cavern in the Philippines around 1945, and the lawyer Dan Sheehan says he has seen photographs of it. He describes the cavern as looking "like a football stadium down underneath the ground." If his account is right, a huge wartime treasure store sat hidden beneath the islands.
